temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits that he has been keeping something from Christian and that he is in some trouble, saying he did not know how to tell him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is hiding something important from him and feels anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. His suspicion is confirmed: Jonathan admits he has been hiding something, specifically that he is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Christian believes Jonathan has been keeping a secret and is in some kind of trouble.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious and suspicious before; after, worried and concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To learn more about Jonathan's trouble and decide how to respond.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian offers help and support. Jonathan says the situation is complicated and he did not want to drag Christian into it, but after Christian insists, Jonathan accepts support and resources to get out of the mess.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is in trouble and is worried about him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. He learns Jonathan is willing to accept his support and needs resources; the trouble is complicated.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Christian believes Jonathan's trouble is complicated, but Jonathan will accept his help and they can face it together.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help and support Jonathan, including providing resources, to help him get out of the mess.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian asks if the trouble is illegal. Jonathan says he cannot say for sure, might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but says he did not do anything illegal himself. Christian says he will look into it discreetly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is in complicated trouble and needs support; he does not yet know if the trouble is criminal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. The nature of Jonathan's trouble shifts from general/complicated to possibly involving criminal activity or wrong people, though Jonathan claims innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Christian believes Jonathan may have gotten involved with wrong people or possible illegal activity, but Jonathan claims he did nothing illegal; the matter needs discreet investigation.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Conflicted and concerned; also cautious and worried.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate the matter further discreetly without alarming Jonathan.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed. He tells Jonathan someone is trying to set him up, says he has leads, and plans to gather more evidence to prove Jonathan's innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan may be involved with wrong people or possible illegal activity, though he is trying to investigate discreetly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. His investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed rather than guilty; the threat is an external setup.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Christian believes Jonathan is innocent and is being framed by someone; evidence is needed to prove it.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear Jonathan's name by gathering evidence to prove his innocence.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian finds out that the real culprit is someone close to both him and Jonathan. He tells Jonathan this and says he will confront the culprit. Jonathan warns him the person is dangerous but says he trusts Christian.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is being framed and is gathering evidence to prove his innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. The culprit is identified as someone close to and trusted by both Christian and Jonathan; this is a betrayal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Christian believes a trusted person close to them is responsible for framing Jonathan and must be brought to justice.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice, ensuring the betrayal does not go unpunished.
